_meta: What a pane agent does when it stops to ask. Product default: answer nothing automatically; escalate every prompt as an approval request (pnpm kyberion approvals / approve / reject) and relay the decision with relay_keys. Installations add auto_answer rules and launch_args in knowledge/personal/governance/agent-prompt-response-policy.json. sign_in, device_code and terms_or_consent are never auto-answered, whatever a rule says.
